high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "madovermarketing_mom." The post features a list with three points explaining why there might be increasing demand for digital currencies: Central Banks claim that there is increasing demand for digital currencies, which they wish to satisfy. A regulated digital currency will also save people from the volatility of private digital currencies like Bitcoin. The cost of issuing these currencies is far lower than printing and distributing physical cash. The post includes the logo "MOM" (Mad Over Marketing) at the bottom center.
